# Discovery and recovery requirements checklist

**Purpose**: Review S009 requirement completeness and concurrency/storage clarity.
**Created**: 2026-10-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Review Ownership**: Generated by `$speckit-checklist` for PR reviewers. Markers record requirements-quality review, never implementation completion. Autopilot continues on the owner's authorization while these reviewer-owned markers remain untouched.

## Completeness and clarity

- [ ] CHK001 Are initial discovery and explicit Refresh progress requirements distinct and measurable? [Completeness, Spec FR-001/FR-002, SC-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are all terminal and empty outcomes defined without an invented known total? [Clarity, Spec FR-002/FR-008]
- [ ] CHK003 Are cancellation boundaries distinguished from OS-call termination? [Clarity, Spec FR-004, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK004 Are session/operation retirement and concurrent Refresh requirements consistent? [Consistency, Spec FR-004/FR-005]
- [ ] CHK005 Is removal of unobserved items limited to complete enumeration? [Coverage, Spec FR-007]
- [ ] CHK006 Are sort/filter/pagination and surviving selection requirements compatible during incremental updates? [Consistency, Spec FR-006]

## Storage and recovery coverage

- [ ] CHK007 Are root identity and descendant-link boundaries stated separately? [Clarity, Spec FR-009/FR-011]
- [ ] CHK008 Are unavailable-root recovery and preference preservation requirements explicit? [Coverage, Spec FR-008]
- [ ] CHK009 Are tested local paths, mounted-storage behavior and unqualified physical/native environments distinguished? [Measurability, Spec FR-010, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK010 Are stale observations, partial iterator failure and changed native resources addressed? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases, FR-007/FR-011]
- [ ] CHK011 Are accessibility, focused playback, source integrity and bounded work requirements retained? [Coverage, Spec FR-011/FR-012/FR-014]
- [ ] CHK012 Are publication/review limits and authoritative/internal documentation boundaries stated? [Completeness, Spec Input, FR-013, SC-005]

## Notes

Standard depth, reviewer audience, concurrency/storage focus. The built-in requirements checklist has its separate specify/clarify lifecycle. `$speckit-implement` reads these markers and does not modify them.
